You kneel, and a cradle of roots lifts your companion as warmth drains from your hands.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One willing creature within 3 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Recovery

Roots gently lift the fallen. Pay 3 HP first, leaving yourself above 0; cost bypasses resistance. Requires a free hand. Life resistance reduces healing, minimum 1.

Weak
Restore 5 HP.
Standard
Restore 9 HP; the target may stand without spending movement.
Strong
Restore 13 HP; the target may stand without spending movement, then move 1 square without provoking.

Additional rulings

Offensive healing — latest agreement: this spell may target an unwilling creature harmed by healing. Resolve it as an attack using its printed attribute, range, action and HP cost; the HP result becomes Life damage, without beneficial recovery riders. This is the explicit exception to willing-only targeting above. Use the creature’s printed defense when a player defends; no opposed second roll.

Source: design/cards/a-bough-for-the-fallen.md at 64089a1c8961d7faff172f179448a8b6e57827ef.
